summary: This is a routine 6-K filing by C21 Investments Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting its annual audited financial statements for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, along with management's discussion and analysis and CEO/CFO certifications. The filing includes an unqualified audit opinion from Davidson Company LLP. There is no mention of any merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The filing is a standard periodic financial report with no special-situation event.
